scope: Functional reconciliation and missing observable development cases. This is not complete release qualification or a candidate-package/historical/platform pass.
amendments: One shipping CIS.Core assembly embeds Microsoft provider; approved Microsoft packages are allowed, third-party integrations isolated.

EnvironmentOptions is a static constructor-initialized facts container with user-selected mutable logging settings before runtime capture; superseded immutable-static configuration prose is not adopted.
Valid oversized entries are truncated and marked, with a configurable default 64 KiB; unsupported values remain invalid and counted.
Creator disposes scope handles in LIFO order; repeated valid disposal is harmless. Universal inherited-child disposal detection is not promised.

unitAreas.originalRequiredCoverage: Missing/blank/valid/invalid values, whitespace/case policy, bounds, every precedence layer, invalid higher-priority input, booleans including `false`, and one-time relative-path resolution despite later working-directory changes.
unitAreas.boundary: Existing actual Core tests and controlled deterministic fixtures; complete concurrency/discovery/coverage reconciliation remains WP07-S01-T03/T04/T05.
unitAreas.applicability: The current 18-key configuration catalog declares no boolean environment key; no invented true/false setting is added. Existing derived ConsoleEnabled/FileEnabled false paths are tested through None/no-path cases. A future boolean key must define and test explicit true/false parsing.
